New Zealand native Alan Broadbent has distinguished himself as a jazz pianist, arranger, and composer. He has collaborated with a diverse list of artists, from Charlie Haden to Paul McCartney, and he is frequently called upon for his distinctive string arrangements.
Alan was interviewed via Zoom on October 26, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive. It’s a great pleasure to have Alan Broadbent with me today. And I’m going to introduce you first as a pianist, orchestrator, arranger, composer, teacher, and just returned from San Francisco, is that right?
